entities.summary: Suleiman the Magnificent, a notable figure in the history of Iraq, associated with Ottoman Iraq (1534–1638). Preceded by Treaty of Zuhab and Suleiman the Magnificent captures Baghdad from the Safavids. Their legacy influenced Mamluk Governors of Baghdad and Georgian Mamluk.
